out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Plan & Specifications Submission - Remodeling, Change of Type, Change of Operation
violations.observation: The permit holder did not submit plans or specifications for remodeling/renovation, change in type of establishment leading to extensive menu change, and/or change in layout/equipment. OBSERVED WATER HEATER MAKE AND MODEL DIFFERENT FROM WHAT WAS ORIGINALLY INSTALLED.
violations.corrective_action: The permit applicant needs to submit the following documents to the Health Department for review and approval: WATER HEATER STATE GS6-50- YRVIT 200.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED RAW SHELL EGGS ON SHELF ABOVE MILK/BUTTERMILK IN WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CFM MOVED RAW SHELL EGGS TO SIDE OF SHELF ABOVE RAW CHICKEN.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: SOMI SAUCE (YOGURT/HERB BASED SAUCE) MARKED WITH DATE 10/3/26.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. CFM DISCARDED SOMI SAUCE.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED BOTH KITCHEN HAND SINK BASINS SLOW TO DRAIN. OBSERVED FLOOR DRAIN AT 3 COMPARTMENT SINK SLOW TO DRAIN.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. EHS RECOMMENDS CONTACTING LICENSED PLUMBER TO ADDRESS DRAINAGE ISSUE. EHS RECOMMENDS HAVING GREASE TRAP CLEANED MONTHLY OR AS NEEDED - GREASE TRAP OBSERVED UNDERGROUND IN DISH WASHING AREA.
